properties.notes: 0819/0039 Construction of 12 dwellings (amendment to ERE/0219/0028 showing the dormer windows relocating to the rear, and roof lights to the front). The site is covered in tarmac and ground contamination is possible. Typical contaminants found in sites similar to this include heavy metals, asbestos, petroleum hydrocarbons and poly nuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). This site is in the SHLAA2019 Ref 168. This development has started.
